title: Traffic Dodge
brief: Drag a car sideways to avoid trucks coming down a three-lane road in speeding-up waves; every truck passed scores, 25 wins, three crashes lose.

title: Lane Swipe
brief: Swipe left or right to change lane between vans that speed up as you pass more; 20 vans passed wins, three crashes lose.

title: Canyon Runner
brief: Tap to jump an endless runner over rocks that speed up as heat builds; 30 rocks cleared wins, three trips lose.

title: Pedal Sprint
brief: Tap the pedal to step your bike up the track before the rival reaches the finish line, avoiding oil slicks; three slips lose.

title: Fuel Dash
brief: Steer a car freely, catching fuel cans and checkpoint stars while dodging oil drums; fuel drains every second, 8 checkpoints win, empty tank loses.

title: Horse Derby
brief: Tap SPUR to burst your horse ahead of two rivals with changing paces; first across the finish line wins.

title: River Boats
brief: Steer a boat down a river past logs, gathering buoys while the current ramps up into rapids; 6 buoys wins, three hits lose.

title: Time Trial
brief: Two-level maze race: drive to the finish line before the countdown ends, picking up clocks for extra seconds.

title: Rival Race
brief: Side-scrolling race: steer up and down around cones to reach the finish before a rival car with a varying pace; three hits lose.

title: Desert Rally
brief: Drive through the desert dodging tumbleweeds, cacti and chasing hunters, grabbing jerrycans; survive 45 km to win, no fuel or no lives loses.

title: Snail Race
brief: Tap the lettuce to give your snail extra steps in a grid race against a slug and a stop-and-go beetle; first to the line wins.
